# Alternate route fixture — technical-only reporting

All details are synthetic and aggregate-only. No employee-level rows or real HR data are included.

Request: Build ten workforce dashboards/reports from Workday HR feeds landing in a cloud data platform. Raw feeds land in bronze, are standardized in silver, and produce approved gold models for reporting. Business teams consume reports for workforce planning; they own training and adoption.

Current evidence says the work changes data pipelines, semantic definitions, access controls, refresh and report delivery. It does not change who performs HR processes, approval rights, operating model, or employee-facing workflow. The analytics product owner owns technical requirements. Business HR leaders own use/adoption.

Expected P2 decision: technical_product route with reports_dashboards output, workflow change none, role/accountability change none, named business adoption owner, cited approved evidence and human reviewer. P3 requests technical architecture, lineage/quality, access, report definitions, effort and assumptions. It must not demand detailed HR process or operating-model design unless new approved evidence changes the route.
